title: Measure animal population server cost and client stalls
acceptance_criteria: What server tick, client frame, GC and sampled-stack evidence accompanies 100 parrots versus 100 kobolds and 40 mixed animals?
Do population counts, authenticated committed ownership, phase markers and actual animal renderer calls establish valid comparable captures?

checks.rationale: Lead-owned real isolated client/server measurement with baseline and canonical 100-parrot population, JFR recordings, tick/frame distributions, GC and sampled stacks. Existing ownership, process lifecycle and native bounds remain in force. Capture adequacy is not a performance pass.
